newsitem.title: HONG KONG: TMCC to launch Euro-Asian DM bond - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: TMCC to launch Euro-Asian DM bond - Oct 23.

text.p: Toyota Motor Credit Corp has mandated Merrill Lynch Deutschland and SBC Warburg to lead an inaugural Euro-Asian Deutsche Mark transaction, said Merrill Lynch International on Wednesday.
The issue size will be one billion marks and have a maturity of five years.
The issue will be listed on the Hong Kong, Singapore, London and Frankfurt exchanges.
Price talk is indicated at five to seven basis points over the bund 8.25 percent September 2001.
An international group of underwriters will be formed.
The official launch will take place on Wednesday in Frankfurt. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
